study type: retrospective chart audit and quality improvement project
exposure: provider adherence to American Academy of Pediatrics guidelines
outcome: provider adherence to AAP guidelines for childhood overweight/obesity
areas for improvement in health care delivery
cohort: A stratified random sample of 175 charts of 6- to 19-year-olds seen for well-child visits in a pediatric primary care center.
finding: Five areas were identified as priorities for change to improve provider adherence to recommendations for identification, prevention, and management of childhood overweight and obesity, including diagnosis based on BMI, parental history of obesity, sleep assessment, endocrine assessment, and attendance at follow-up visits.
